about.title: Our Story
about.text: We're two women who fell in love — with each other and with baking. What started as a kitchen experiment in Kiefer, Oklahoma turned into a full-blown obsession with creating the perfect cake ball. Every batch is handcrafted with premium ingredients and a whole lot of heart. Welcome to Le Besian Balls — where every bite is made with love.
